Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Notice about parking for the tax consultation session starting at 9:30 AM on February 9 (Monday).

Regarding use of the parking lot at Hanno Komachi Park (in front of the south side of the Chamber of Commerce):

As of 3:30 PM on February 8 (Sunday), road conditions in the park grounds are poor due to snow accumulation.

Following arrangements with Hanno Odori Shopping Street (which manages the lot on behalf of Hanno City), the parking lot cannot be used when road conditions are unsafe. The park is a public facility and this restriction applies when surfaces are compromised.

We will make a judgment based on tomorrow's conditions. If there is no parking lot sign visible on the road surface, that area is not available for parking.

In that case, please use nearby coin parking facilities.

We plan to open the lot as road conditions improve, so we ask for your understanding in advance.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2362/
